notes:
InMails now have their own quota and no longer count against the daily limit for regular messages. Before this, the two took the limit away from each other.

New tile on the messages tab showing the InMail credits used today and the monthly total, visible with Sales Navigator.

The Sales Nav Filter and Sales Nav InMail modes only appear when Sales Navigator is selected in the settings.

Withdrawing old invitations is much faster: the list is only scrolled until enough matching invitations are found, instead of going through all of it. With several hundred open invitations this saves minutes.

New tile on the connect tab showing how many invitations were withdrawn today.

The browser window starts minimized so the automation does not take over your screen. Can be turned off in the settings under Browser window. It always stays visible for a manual login.
